title: Truth-table CNF formula
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean-valued function on sign vectors of length $r$. Form a CNF formula with one clause for each sign vector $x$ on which $f(x)=1$, where that clause excludes $x$ by using, at each coordinate, the sign opposite to $x$; the formula has no clauses for inputs on which $f$ is not $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps sign vectors of length $r$ to signs
